name: Cheech & Chong - Live Resin 3.5g - Sundae Driver
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Cheech & Chong Sundae Driver live resin delivers 3.5 grams of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Sundae Driver is a balanced hybrid born from crossing Fruity Pebbles OG with Grape Pie, and the flavor delivers on both sides of that cross. Expect sweet grape and berry up front, layered with rich, creamy dessert notes and a smooth, subtly earthy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect than standard extracts — a mellow, feel-good calm paired with a gentle mood lift that stays easygoing start to finish.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Sundae Driver flavor — sweet grape and berry with rich, creamy dessert notes
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Cheech & Chong Sundae Driver is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
